dict.string: SambaVault needs local network access to discover, probe, and mount Samba (SMB/CIFS) network storage shares on your LAN.
SambaVault needs access to your Desktop folder to discover and catalog media files.
SambaVault needs access to your Documents folder to scan, catalog, and index media libraries.
SambaVault needs access to your Downloads folder to scan and import downloaded media files.
SambaVault needs access to removable volumes (external USB drives, external SSDs) to scan and sync media libraries.
SambaVault needs access to network volumes (SMB, Samba, NFS shares) to scan and sync movies, series, and music.
